claims.claim: Genie 4 generates realtime interactive 3D scenes with sound using natural language prompts.
claims.episode_span: You type a simple prompt like “a mouse at a Victorian high tea” and the scene appears right away, complete with moving characters, changing weather, and even sound.
claims.source_title: Genie 4 safety guardrails and SynthID watermarking
claims.supporting_quote: Genie 4 includes strict safety guardrails, and all generated audio and video is watermarked with SynthID.

claims.claim: Classical philologists developed methods to separate attested fragments from later interpretations using brackets and different typefaces.
claims.episode_span: When they guess at a missing word, they put the guess in brackets or a different font so everyone can see exactly where the real evidence ends and the scholar’s best guess begins.
claims.source_title: Philologists have reasoned from fragmentary evidence for 200 years. LLMs still confabulate when context is missing.
claims.supporting_quote: When a philologist reconstructs a lacuna in a papyrus, the reconstruction is printed in brackets or in a different typeface.
